utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: Call the case, please, Mr. Court Deputy.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Good morning, Your Honours. This is case number IT-02-63-I, the Prosecutor versus Drago Nikolic.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: Thank you. Good morning, ladies and gentlemen. To begin with, could I have the appearances, please. For the Prosecution.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Good morning, Your Honour. Peter McCloskey, and along with me are Antoinette Issa and Janet Stewart.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: Thank you. And for the Defence? MR. VAN DER SPOEL: Good morning, Your Honour. Tjarda van der Spoel, duty counsel for Mr. Nikolic.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: Thank you very much. We'll proceed with the Initial Appearance of the accused, Mr. Drago Nikolic, pursuant to Rule 62 of the Rules of Procedure and Evidence. Mr. Nikolic, can you hear the proceedings in a language that you understand?

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Yes, I can, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: Could you please give your full name for the record.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] I am Drago Nikolic.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: What is your date of birth?

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] I was born on the 9th of November, 1957.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: What is the address at which you resided before you were transferred to the custody of this International Tribunal?

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] I live in Jugoslavenska Narodni Armija Street number 63, Banja Koviljaca, municipality of Loznica, Republic of Serbia.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: Mr. Nikolic, have you received the indictment against you in a language you understand and did you have a chance to read it?

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Yes, I received the indictment, and I've read it.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: Have you had an opportunity to discuss the indictment with your counsel and do you understand its contents?

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] I did not really discuss I want -- it with my counsel, since I have not appointed a permanent counsel yet.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: Well, Mr. Spoel, are you counsel assigned just for the Initial Appearance or for the future proceedings? MR. VAN DER SPOEL: Your Honour, I am duty counsel for the moment for Mr. Nikolic. I talked to him about the indictment. But he did not want to discuss the indictment in detail with me because he was -- wanted to choose his own Defence counsel.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: But of course, you know, this is just for the purpose Blank page inserted to ensure pagination corresponds between the French and English transcripts. of the Initial Appearance. And is your client prepared to plead today? MR. VAN DER SPOEL: I talked to him about -- about that yesterday. He is not prepared to plead today, but he will plead within 30 days.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: I see. You may sit down, please. MR. VAN DER SPOEL: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: Well, Mr. Nikolic, I have to tell you that you have the right to plead to each count today or within 30 days from the Initial Appearance. Should you fail to enter a plea within this time limit, the Trial Chamber shall enter a plea of not guilty on your behalf. Do you understand that?

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Yes, I understand.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: I hope you could find an opportunity to discuss the indictment with Mr. Spoel or with other counsel you are choosing and be ready to plead within the 30 days from today.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] I hope so, and it will surely be like that, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: Thank you very much. Do you have any other things to bring to my attention, or do you have any complaints during your stay in the Detention Unit?

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] I have no complaints regarding my stay in the Detention Unit. The personnel behaves professionally. The food is fine. My health is fine. So I have nothing to state right now, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: Thank you very much. Please take care of yourself. You may sit down.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] I will, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: You may sit down, please.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: Well, at this stage, are there any matters that the parties would like to bring to the attention of this Bench? Mr. McCloskey?

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Your Honour, nothing substantive; just to point out that, as you know, there are several accused from this case, and the Prosecution will be moving to -- to join the various accused and -- and have the indictment to be one indictment that will involve all of them. And we have the supporting material when -- when the accused and his regular counsel want it.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: Yes. But at this stage, I believe that I am ready to -- I am not ready to deal with this issue, and after the accused enters his plea, we'll consider that. Mr. Spoel, do you have anything to bring to my attention at this stage? MR. VAN DER SPOEL: No, thank you, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: Thank you very much. Well, I guess that's all for today, and the hearing is adjourned.

procedural_notes.text: --- Whereupon the Initial Appearance adjourned at
